itens.trecho: Show de um homem só. Este filme mostra uma história de sobrevivência, ao estilo "Robinson Crusoe", algo pouco comum no cinema de hoje. Consiste num drama psicológico profundo, que explora brilhantemente o desespero, a depressão, a necessidade de sobreviver em condições extremas, a saudade de casa, a solidão.

We live and we die by time. And we must not commit the sin of losing our track on time. This review may contain spoilers Jetting off on yet another important task, FedEx whizzer Chuck Noland leaves his girlfriend Kelly Frears (Helen Hunt) behind just before Christmas. Disaster strikes during the flight and the plane crashes into the ocean.

Cast Away is a brilliant movie in many ways, but some disappointing story and character decisions keep it from being a personal favorite. It all began on Christmas Day. Many people forget that Cast Away is technically a Christmas movie.
